selection_boundary: V2/AG6 can never add candidates, tune V3 candidates, or alter B0 thresholds.

eligible_source_rule.pretrade_state: recorder receive time strictly earlier than linked venue trade; equal receive time is AMBIGUOUS unless source sequence proves ordering
eligible_source_rule.pooling: forbidden; report source directory/window strata separately

005H-C01-RELATIVE-SIZE.test: same state baseline: relative episode-size/touch-depth model versus absolute episode-size model on aggressor-signed 30s movement
005H-C01-RELATIVE-SIZE.supported: relative-size R2 difference > 0 in the aggregate eligible source record and positive in a majority of sufficiently supported source strata
005H-C01-RELATIVE-SIZE.source_specific: aggregate or majority-stratum direction does not reproduce
005H-C01-RELATIVE-SIZE.untestable: touch depth or strict 30s outcome chronology cannot be reconstructed

005H-C02-FAILED-REPLENISHMENT.test: failed 80% recovery of consumed-side 2c depth within 30s versus recovered states on aggressor-signed 30s movement
005H-C02-FAILED-REPLENISHMENT.supported: failed-minus-recovered gap > 0 in aggregate and positive in a majority of sufficiently supported source strata
005H-C02-FAILED-REPLENISHMENT.source_specific: aggregate or majority-stratum direction does not reproduce
005H-C02-FAILED-REPLENISHMENT.untestable: depth or strict post-trade chronology cannot be reconstructed

005H-C03-FILL-BEYOND-STATE.test: without-replacement same-token matched non-fill controls; fill-minus-control aggressor-signed 30s movement
005H-C03-FILL-BEYOND-STATE.supported: aggregate gap > 0 and positive in a majority of sufficiently supported source strata
005H-C03-FILL-BEYOND-STATE.source_specific: aggregate or majority-stratum direction does not reproduce
005H-C03-FILL-BEYOND-STATE.untestable: strict fill chronology or comparable non-fill state construction is unavailable

005H-C04-ARRIVAL-STATE.supported: exact frozen feature semantics reconstructable and AUC > 0.50 in majority of supported strata
005H-C04-ARRIVAL-STATE.source_specific: feature parity exists but direction fails
005H-C04-ARRIVAL-STATE.untestable: any frozen feature lacks source-semantic parity

005H-C05-DIRECTION-STATE.supported: exact frozen feature semantics reconstructable and AUC > 0.50 in majority of supported strata
005H-C05-DIRECTION-STATE.source_specific: feature parity exists but direction fails
005H-C05-DIRECTION-STATE.untestable: any frozen feature lacks source-semantic parity

005H-C06-BOOK-MICROSTRUCTURE-CHALLENGER.supported: exact shortlisted challenger and baseline semantics reconstructable and challenger-minus-baseline R2 > 0 in majority of supported strata
005H-C06-BOOK-MICROSTRUCTURE-CHALLENGER.source_specific: feature parity exists but direction fails
005H-C06-BOOK-MICROSTRUCTURE-CHALLENGER.untestable: OFI/microprice or baseline feature parity cannot be proven

b0_effect: Source-version results never add or retune candidates. SOURCE_SPECIFIC or UNTESTABLE_SOURCE is carried into the final caveat and future-confirmation boundary; same-source V3 B0 remains a separate one-shot test.
